The David Rockefeller Graduate Program
The Rockefeller University
APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS AND PROCEDURE
____________________________________________________________________________________________________
Requirements for Admission
The Rockefeller University is a competitive graduate institution. Students who enter the Ph.D. program must have received a
degree of bachelor or master of arts or sciences, or doctor of medicine or equivalent international qualification. In demonstrating
merit, applicants should be able to document a high level of achievement in the biological, chemical, mathematical or physical
sciences. In addition to these qualifications, applicants will have the opportunity to describe their scientific interests and goals,
as well as the unique perspectives they would bring to the Rockefeller community.
Applicants must be prepared to engage directly in graduate studies through advanced coursework and research activities.
Students who are accepted will receive free tuition, a stipend (currently $55,600), affordable housing on or near our attractive
campus, health coverage and an allowance for research, books and meetings. Students are required to devote their full time to
graduate work and may not undertake additional employment.
Application Procedure
The complete application should reach us by December 1, 2026.
All documents listed below must be submitted to complete your application:
1— The completed Online Application Form, including a Statement of Purpose comprised of three sections, designed
to help us understand you as a scientist, a future Ph.D. student at Rockefeller, and a member of our community. You
are asked to:
• Reflect on your most meaningful research experience and how you approached it. (Limit: 750 words)
• Describe your scientific interests going forward and how they align with the work of specific Rockefeller
faculty. (Limit: 250 words)
• Share how your background and experiences would enrich the Rockefeller community. (Limit: 250 words)
Detailed instructions for each section are provided in the Applicant Statements section of the online application.
2— An Official Transcript from each college or university you attended and listed in the Educational Information section
of your application. You must scan and upload a copy of each official transcript as part of the online application.
3— Recommendations from three or four sponsors who can assess your potential for research.
4— A Curriculum Vitae (CV) or Resume
5— The Application Fee of $50 is payable by check or credit card (preferred payment method).
General and Advanced Subject Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores and TOEFL scores are not required for
admission. GRE and TOEFL scores are not requested on our application and will not be reviewed as part of the admissions
process.
Review of Applications and Interviews
Applications are reviewed by the Admissions Committee, representing the various areas of biological science. You will be
notified about the status of your application as soon as possible, but no later than December 31st.
Selected candidates will be invited to interview with faculty February 18-19 and February 25-26, 2027 during on-campus
Open House visits. Please try to keep these dates free until you hear from us. Hotel accommodation will be provided, and
expenses will be reimbursed up to a maximum amount of $600 for domestic and $750 for international travel.
Any application documents not submitted online should be mailed to:
Dean’s Office
The Rockefeller University
1230 York Avenue, Box 177
New York, NY 10065-6399
